title: GoAria Extractor Manifest
description: Schema definition for GoAria WebAssembly extractor pack manifest.json (ABI v1).

pack_id.description: Unique identifier for the extractor pack; starts and ends with a lowercase letter or digit.

pack_version.description: Non-empty trimmed version string without ASCII whitespace, NUL, or path separators.

description.description: Short summary describing what URLs this extractor handles.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities required by the extractor pack.

host.description: Hostname or domain matching this rule (e.g. 'fixture.invalid').

include_subdomains.description: Whether to match all subdomains under this host.

domains.description: List of domain rules matched by this extractor.

timeout_millis.description: Host wall-clock execution deadline in milliseconds; the local wasmi runner maps it to an approximate fuel budget.

max_memory_pages.description: Maximum memory limit in 64KB pages (32 pages = 2MB).

max_host_calls.description: Maximum number of host calls permitted during execution.

max_response_bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of host HTTP fetch responses.

max_output_items.description: Maximum number of extracted items allowed in ExtractOutput.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum total bytes of serialized ExtractOutput JSON.

payload_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 digest of payload.wasm (injected during packaging).
